title: Kon Jeetega ?
description:
DIET PLAN (PROFESSIONAL BOXER - 24 HRS)
MORNING (5 AM) - 500 ML WARM WATER, APPLE CIDER VINEGAR.
PRE-WORKOUT MEAL -
30G OATS, 5 EGG WHITES, 2 WHOLE EGGS.
INTRA-WORKOUT DRINK - 5G GLUTAMINE, 3G CREATINE,
1 SCOOP EAA IN 1 LITRE WATER.
POST-WORKOUT MEAL -
100G RICE, 180G CHICKEN, VEGETABLES.
MEAL 3 -
150G CHICKEN, VEGETABLES.
FRUITS - PAPAYA, PINEAPPLE.
MEAL 5 -
150G CHICKEN, RICE, VEGETABLES.
NIGHT - 15 ALMONDS

WORKOUT PLAN
CONDITIONING -
JUMP ROPE, SHADOW BOXING.
BOXING TRAINING - HEAVY BAG WORK, PUNCH COMBINATIONS.
GYM (BACK & BICEPS) - SEATED ROWS, T-BAR ROWS,
HYPEREXTENSIONS, DUMBBELL CURLS.
CARDIO FINISHER - 20 MINUTES HIIT
